stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They are less good at knowing what people might become interested in.”?
options: Sometimes people improve faster when they are not afraid of being judged.
Sometimes an object becomes important because of the feelings people leave there.
Discovery sometimes requires leaving the comfortable path that technology builds around you.
Clean water requires both technology and care for people.
